title: AI boom sustains S. Korea's growth despite global headwinds: IMF official
caption:
Despite global trade uncertainty and regional conflicts, South Korea's growth forecast was revised upward to 3.3 percent. Multi-year commitments to build AI server facilities are keeping memory chip demand unusually resilient.
